content_sections.heading: IHE Section Officer Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the post of Section Officer on a deputation basis.

rows.qualification_required: A Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from any recognised Institute/ University.Officers holding analogous posts on a regular basis or with three years regular service in Pay Level-6 or equivalent in the Central/State Govt. Universities or autonomous organisations.

content_sections.heading: IHE Section Officer Age Limit
content_sections.text: The maximum age limit for appointment by Deputation shall not exceed 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications, i.e. 28.10.2026.

content_sections.heading: IHE Section Officer Salary
content_sections.text: The notification does not mention any additional allowances or benefits.

rows.pay_level_pay: Level-07 entry pay of Rs.44,900/- as per 7th CPC Pay matrix

content_sections.heading: IHE Section Officer Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notification does not specify a written test, interview, or detailed selection stages beyond deputation rules and routing through the proper channel.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IHE Section Officer
content_sections.text: Download the prescribed application form from the official website https://ihe.du.ac.in . Fill up the application form completely and sign it. Attach attested photocopies of APARs for the last three years for the post of Section Officer. Attach the Integrity and Vigilance Clearance Certificate. Attach the No Objection Certificate. Send the completed application form along with all enclosures by Post to "The Director, Institute of Home Economics, (University of Delhi), Hauz Khas Enclave, New Delhi-110916". Ensure the application reaches on or before 28.10.2026.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Duly filled Application Form Attested photocopies of APARs for the last three years Integrity and Vigilance Clearance Certificate No Objection Certificate

content_sections.heading: IHE Section Officer Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Application of only such candidates will be considered which are routed through the proper channel. Applications received late and/ or without the required documents will not be considered. The period of deputation is initially for one year, extendable as per the requirement of the College and at the discretion of the College. The College reserves the right not to fill the vacancy and/or reduce the tenure of the deputation at the discretion of the College. In case of any inadvertent mistake in the process of selection, the college reserves the right to modify/withdraw/cancel any communication made to the candidate.

faq.question: Q1. What is the IHE Section Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification issued by the Institute of Home Economics (University of Delhi) to fill 1 Section Officer post on a deputation basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Section Officer post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for IHE Section Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed application form by post is 28.10.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Section Officer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognised Institute/University, and hold analogous posts on a regular basis or have three years regular service in Pay Level-6 or equivalent in Central/State Govt. Universities or autonomous organisations.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for IHE Section Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation shall not exceed 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications, i.e. 28.10.2026.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the IHE Section Officer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must send their duly filled and signed application form along with required enclosures by post through proper channel to The Director, Institute of Home Economics, (University of Delhi), Hauz Khas Enclave, New Delhi-110916.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for the IHE Section Officer post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a Level-07 entry pay of Rs.44,900/- as per the 7th CPC Pay matrix.

faq.question: Q9. Is a No Objection Certificate required to apply?
faq.answer: Yes, applicants must provide a No Objection Certificate along with their application through proper channel.
